author: nickyeow

english.text: I can't take it anymore! I haven't slept for three days!

jyutping: ngo5 ji5 ging1 saam1 jat6 mou4 fan3 gwo3 laa3，zan1 hai6 gui6 dou3 sei2 aa3！

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm only reading the scraps on news on the Internet, but, well, I get the general picture.

jyutping: seoi1 jin4 ngo5 zing6 hai6 hai2 mong5 soeng6 tai2 zo2 gei2 pin1 san1 man4，daan6 hai6 dou1 daai6 koi3 zi1 dou6 zo2 sing4 gin6 si6 ge3 loi4 lung4 heoi3 mak6。
text: 雖然我淨係喺網上睇咗幾篇新聞，但係都大概知道咗成件事嘅來龍去脈。

author: nickyeow

english.text: My parents keep arguing about stupid things. It's so annoying!

jyutping: ngo5 aa3 baa4 aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 wai4 maai4 di1 zi1 maa4 luk6 dau2 ge3 je5 hai2 dou6 aai3 gaau1，zan1 hai6 faan4 dou3 sei2 aa3！
text: 我阿爸阿媽成日為埋啲芝麻綠豆嘅嘢喺度嗌交，真係煩到死呀！

author: nickyeow

english.text: Hello!

jyutping: haa1 lou2。
text: 哈佬。

english.text: I don't think she takes after her mother.

jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 tung4 keoi5 aa3 maa1 dou1 m4 hai6 hou2 ci5。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm tired of watching television.

jyutping: ngo5 tai2 din6 si6 tai2 dou2 jim3 laa3。

english.text: Don't call me up after ten o'clock.

jyutping: sap6 dim2 zi1 hau6 m4 hou2 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 ngo5。

jyutping: zoeng1 toi2 haa6 min6 jau5 nap1 ping4 gwo2。

author: nickyeow

english.text: What do you want to eat?

english.text: Bob saw him again.

jyutping: aa3 Bob jau6 gin3 faan1 keoi5 laa3。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm used to working all night.

jyutping: ngo5 gwaan3 zo2 tung1 siu1 zou6 je5。

english.text: Keep the dog out.

jyutping: m4 hou2 bei2 zek3 gau2 jap6 lai4。

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 zi1 dou6 zi6 gei2 zou6 gan2 di1 me1，gam3 zau6 m4 giu3 zou6 jin4 gau3 laa1，hai6 mai6 sin1？

english.text: Carolan wanted to learn how the organisms did that. So he studied the liver proteins of the two genetically-different mice. He and his team found that the liver cells of resistant mice had more copies of a protein than the mice that were more likely to be infected. The proteins create a chemical which the researchers believe could be toxic to the parasitic cells. But they are not sure.

text: 卡羅蘭想知道呢啲生物係點樣做到呢一點，所以佢研究咗兩隻基因上唔同嘅老鼠嘅肝臟蛋白質，佢同佢嘅團隊發現，抗性老鼠嘅肝細胞有更多蛋白質嘅抄本，而唔係更有可能咁做 被感染嘅蛋白質會產生一種化學物質，研究人員相信呢種化學物質可能對寄生細胞有毒。

english.text: Developed over four years by hundreds of the Nation’s top climate scientists and technical experts—and informed by thousands of inputs from the public and outside organizations gathered through town hall meetings, public-comment opportunities, and technical workshops across the country, the third National Climate Assessment represents the most authoritative and comprehensive knowledge base about how climate change is affecting America now, and what’s likely to come over the next century.

text: 由全國幾百位頂尖氣候科學家同技術專家喺四年內開發出嚟，並且由公眾同外部組織嘅幾千個投入提供資料，呢個係透過全國各地嘅市政廳會議、公眾意見機會同技術研討會而聚集埋一齊嘅，係第三屆全國氣候 評估代表咗關於氣候變化而家點樣影響美國，同埋下個世紀可能會發生啲咩嘅最權威同全面嘅知識庫。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: On the 1st of March of 2022, I went twice to the pizzeria, once in the morning when I had butter chicken pizza and later in the afternoon when I had mushroom spinach pesto cheese chicken pizza, both times in which I drank a black effervescent drink. In the morning, there were two fire trucks illumined at the mall. In the afternoon, there were handsome men. A lady wore a leopard shawl. Two Hispanics entered. Tharsan the Sri Lankan owner was speaking to an advertising agent lady.

text: 喺2022年3月1號，我去過兩次薄餅舖，一次係朝早食牛油雞薄餅，同埋下午後來食蘑菇菠菜香蒜芝士雞薄餅，兩次都係飲咗一杯黑色氣泡飲品。朝早，商場有兩架消防車照亮。下晝，有啲靚仔。有位女士着住豹紋披肩。兩個西班牙裔人士入嚟。斯里蘭卡老闆 Tharsan 同一位廣告代理女士講緊嘢。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: We all live, at any rate for a time, and the majority of us always, in polygamy. Consequently, as each man needs many women, nothing is more just than to let him, nay, make it incumbent upon him to provide for many women. By this means woman will be brought back to her proper and natural place as a subordinate being.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 dou1 saang1 wut6 hai2 jat1 fu1 do1 cai1 zai3，mou4 leon6 dim2 joeng2 dou1 hai6 jat1 dyun6 si4 gaan1，ji4 ngo5 dei6 daai6 bou6 fan6 jan4 wing5 jyun5 dou1 hai6 jat1 fu1 do1 cai1 zai3。so2 ji5，jau4 jyu1 mui5 go3 naam4 jan4 dou1 seoi1 jiu3 hou2 do1 neoi5 jan4，so2 ji5 mou5 je5 bei2 keoi5，m4 hai6，ling6 keoi5 jau5 zaak3 jam6 heoi3 gung1 jing3 hou2 do1 neoi5 jan4 gang1 gung1 ping4。gam2 joeng2，neoi5 jan4 zau6 wui6 bei6 daai2 faan1 heoi3 keoi5 zok3 wai4 jat1 go3 cung4 suk6 cyun4 zoi6 ge3 zing3 kok3 tung4 zi6 jin4 ge3 dei6 fong1。
text: 我哋都生活喺一夫多妻制，無論點樣都係一段時間，而我哋大部分人永遠都係一夫多妻制。所以，由於每個男人都需要好多女人，所以冇嘢畀佢，唔係，令佢有責任去供應好多女人更公平。噉樣，女人就會被帶返去佢作為一個從屬存在嘅正確同自然嘅地方。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: This is not an elitist issue; this is a quality-of-life issue. You want to tell people that their concern and their desire for clean air and clean water is elitist? Tell that to the kids in the South Bronx, which are suffering from the highest rates of childhood asthma in the country. Tell that to the families in Flint, whose kids have—their blood is ascending in lead levels. Their brains are damaged for the rest of their lives. Call them elitist.

jyutping: ni1 go3 m4 hai6 zing1 jing1 zyu2 ji6 ge3 man6 tai4；ni1 go3 hai6 sang1 wut6 zat1 sou3 ge3 man6 tai4。nei5 soeng2 tung4 jan4 gong2，keoi5 dei6 gwaan1 sam1 gon1 zeng6 hung1 hei3 tung4 gon1 zeng6 seoi2 ge3 jau1 leoi6 tung4 hot3 mong6 hai6「zing1 jing1 zyu2 ji6」？nei5 heoi3 tung4 naam4 bou3 long5 hak1 si1（South Bronx）ge3 sai3 lou6 gong2 laa1，keoi5 dei6 hai6 cyun4 gwok3 tung4 nin4 haau1 cyun2 seot1 zeoi3 gou1 ge3 dei6 fong1。nei5 heoi3 tung4 fat1 lam4 dak6（Flint）ge3 gaa1 ting4 gong2 faan2，keoi5 dei6 ge3 sai3 lou6 hyut3 jik6 ham4 jyun4 loeng4 soeng6 sing1，nou5 bou6 wing5 gau2 sau6 syun2，jat1 sai3 dou1 sau1 fuk6 m4 dou2。nei5 heoi3 giu3 keoi5 dei6「zing1 jing1」si3 haa5。
text: 呢個唔係精英主義嘅問題；呢個係生活質素嘅問題。你想同人講，佢哋關心乾淨空氣同乾淨水嘅憂慮同渴望係「精英主義」？你去同南布朗克斯（South Bronx）嘅細路講啦，佢哋係全國童年哮喘率最高嘅地方。你去同弗林特（Flint）嘅家庭講返，佢哋嘅細路血液含鉛量上升，腦部永久受損，一世都修復唔到。你去叫佢哋「精英」試吓。
